title: InventX 2026 — Summer Program for Inventors
content:
InventX 2026 is a six-week fully residential summer program where selected engineering, science and design students work in teams to build real, patentable inventions with intensive mentoring and prototyping support.

Since 2018 the program has trained 200+ students from IITs, NITs and many other colleges and led to over 120 provisional patent applications in India and the US.

### Key Highlights
- **Focus**: Learn how to invent, build working prototypes, file a provisional patent and pitch your idea.
- **Duration**: 25 May to 3 July 2026, with the finale on 4 July.
- **Fully Residential**: Strong peer learning, teamwork and communication skills.
- **Eligibility**: Students from all engineering, science and design colleges in India can apply.
- **Application Deadline**: 25 April 2026.

If you are serious about innovation and product building, do apply for InventX 2026 before 25 April.

title: ToyNova 2026 — National Toy Innovation Hackathon
content:
Building on the phenomenal success of the ToyBiz Innovation Challenge 2025 — which saw 170+ innovative designs and nationwide participation — The Toy Association of India (TAI), in collaboration with **Srijan Sanchar** as Innovation Partner, is proud to announce the launch of **ToyNova 2026**.

India has always been a land of storytelling and imagination. ToyNova 2026 is designed to bridge our rich heritage with modern technology, transforming toys into AI-enabled learning tools and inclusive companions that drive the vision of an Atmanirbhar Bharat.

### Innovation Focus & Problem Statements
We are looking for creative solutions across four key pillars:
- **Affordable AI Toys**: Budget-friendly, interactive learning tools.
- **Future Toy 2030**: Tech-enhanced toys rooted in Indian cultural values.
- **Inclusive & Therapeutic Toys**: Designs for the elderly, neurodivergent, or visually impaired.
- **DIY Learning Toys**: Sustainable kits that inspire hands-on creativity.

### Why Participate?
Selected finalists will receive:
- **Cash Prizes**: Up to ₹25,000 for top winners.
- **National Platform**: Showcase your prototype at the ToyBiz 2026 Expo in Bharat Mandapam (Pragati Maidan), New Delhi.
- **Industry Access**: Direct mentorship, incubation pathways, and interaction with industry leaders.

### Key Timeline
- **Submission Deadline**: 30 May 2026
- **Jury Evaluation**: June 2026
- **Grand Finale & Awards**: July 2026 (During ToyBiz Expo)

### Who Can Apply?
This challenge is open to all students, designers, startups, engineers, and educators (Age 18+).

Join us in shaping the future of the Indian toy industry and establishing "Brand India" on the global stage!

title: REVA TRACKathon
content:
Dear REVA University Students, Faculty, Staff, Parents and Alumni!!

Are you ready to learn, imagine and innovate together?

We are thrilled to announce a spontaneous, high-energy event happening TOMORROW: The REVA TRACKathon.

This is not just another hackathon; it’s a Learnathon. Whether you want to dive deep into AI to learn new skills, create impressive content for your courses, automate a boring task using no-code low-code platforms, work on your research activities using AI, create AI agents to work for you using OpenClaw or simply learn to be Enterprising, this is your dedicated time to make it happen. Non-teaching staff can automate something for their departments or just learn the usage of AI.

The best part? No prior knowledge / skill needed - Only the enterprising attitude to show up!!! We will have mentors to assist you in your tasks you plan in case you get stuck, or in case you need to understand what’s possible.

Students, Faculty and Staff can team up! You can work solo, or form cross-disciplinary, mixed teams to Learn and Create something truly unique.

### Choose Your TRACK:
Your project or learning outcome should align with one of our five core pillars (TRACK):
- **T - Teaching Learning**: Build educational games, interactive modules, or new teaching aids.
- **R - Research**: Kickstart a research paper, analyze a dataset, or build research tools.
- **A - Academic Administration**: Automate University workflows, use / build tool to analyze data, or streamline daily administrative tasks.
- **C - Consulting and Product Development**: Build real-world products, draft consulting proposals, or code the MVP of your next big idea.
- **K - Kaizen (Self-Improvement & University Building)**: Focus on self-learning. Master AI from basics to advanced concepts, or brainstorm ways to make REVA even better.

### 💡 What Can You Do?
The goal is to create or update an artifact by the end of the day. You could (but not limited to):
- Create amazing content for your courses including interactive applications and games
- Set up and run local LLMs like Ollama or platforms such as OpenClaw.
- Learn applied AI and build a custom agents / prompt library for your department.
- Automate workflows using AI such as grading assignments or creating question banks or processing resumes.
- Develop a gamified learning app for a specific syllabus topic.
- Read, synthesize, and outline a research paper.

Your imagination is the limit!!!

### 📅 Event Details:
- **Date**: Tomorrow, Saturday, March 14th
- **Time**: 9:30 AM to 4:30 PM. (Demo: 3:30 to 4:30 PM)
- **Awards**: All those who showcase a significant contribution will be given a certificate and may be a memento!
- **Venue**: Room 318, Swami Vivekananda Block
- **Who can join**: All REVA students, faculty, staff, alumni and parents

### 🛠️ What to Bring:
- Your laptop and charger, Water bottle and anything else you need to work.
- A collaborative enterprising spirit and a thirst for learning.
- Your boldest ideas!

👉 The first member to register should give their team a name and others can use the same name during their registration.

title: Google.org Impact Challenge: AI for Science
content:
Google.org is inviting academic institutions and nonprofits to apply for the AI for Science Impact Challenge. This is a major opportunity for REVA University researchers and departments.

### Eligibility
- **Who can apply**: Academic institutions (including universities like REVA)
- **Focus areas**: AI for Health & Life Sciences; AI for Climate Resilience & Environmental Science
- **Key requirements**: AI must be core to the solution; evidence-based proposal; open-source licensing

### Program Details
- **Funding**: $500,000 – $3 million USD
- **Accelerator**: Optional 6-month Google.org Accelerator with pro bono technical support
- **Deadline**: April 17, 2026

### Immediate Action for Faculty
Designate a faculty lead to prepare a proposal on AI-driven health or climate research before April 17.

title: Google PhD Fellowship 2026 (India)
content:
Google has announced the PhD Fellowship 2026 for India, offering a stipend of up to $50,000 USD (approx. ₹47 lakh) over 4 years.

### Eligibility
- **Students**: Incoming or early-stage PhD students at accredited Indian institutions
- **Field**: Full-time PhD in Computer Science or adjacent fields
- **Key Rule**: University nomination is **REQUIRED** — students cannot apply directly.

### Application Process for REVA University
1. **Internal Step**: Contact REVA's Department of Computer Science/Graduate School about the internal nomination process immediately.
2. **University Limit**: REVA can nominate up to **4 students** maximum.
3. **Internal Deadline**: April 1, 2026 (Today! Check with your department now).
4. **Documents**: Transcripts, 2–3 letters of recommendation, CVs, and a 3-page research proposal.

### Immediate Action
Contact your Department Head **today** about internal nominations — the window is closing rapidly!

title: Y Combinator's 2026 Request for Startups
content:
Y Combinator has released its 2026 Request for Startups, signaling a major shift in how the next generation of category-defining companies will be built. AI is no longer just a feature—it's an operator across finance, government, industry, and labor.

### 10 Key Areas of Focus:
1. **Cursor for Product Managers**: AI-native systems helping teams decide *what* to build.
2. **AI-Native Hedge Funds**: Autonomous intelligence for quantitative research and trading.
3. **AI-Native Agencies**: Selling finished results and outcomes instead of just software tools.
4. **Stablecoin Financial Services**: Building the financial layer on top of compliant stablecoins.
5. **AI for Government**: Modernizing public services to handle the surge in digital automation.
6. **Modern Metal Mills**: Software-defined industrial operators rebuilding US industrial foundations.
7. **AI Guidance for Physical Work**: Real-time multimodal guidance for skilled labor.
8. **Large Spatial Models**: AI systems that reason about physical geometry and structure.
9. **Government Fraud Hunters**: Intelligent systems for automated evidence and recovery cases.
10. **Make LLMs Easy to Train**: Better tooling for post-training, specialization, and ML research.

YC is looking for founders willing to build where complexity, regulation, and the real world collide.
